Athel Tree provides information technology services specializing in programming, design, and project analysis. It develops and implements model solutions to create an integrated system that elevates the company for the better and characterizes the work of an individual and distinctive interface through the design of a unique website that suits the work environment of the company and through which opens new doors to work.

Athel Tree was established in 2016 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
